title: Decontamination Basics
description: Explains when decontamination is needed and the basic step-by-step process, with specifics for chemical, biological, and radiological contamination, eyes, and wounds. Covers setting up a decon area at home or improvised, common mistakes, and safely helping someone else decontaminate.
shortDescription: Step-by-step decon for chemical, biological, and radiological exposure
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
